298	// artifactTextFields lists the formal artifact members whose value, once the
299	// member is written out, must be a JSON string.
300	var artifactTextFields = []string{"name", "abi", "bytecode", "source"}
301	
302	// validateFormalArtifactFields checks the raw JSON token of every written
303	// formal artifact member before the strict submission is decoded into the Go
304	// wireArtifact string fields. Decoding straight into a Go string turns a
305	// formal null member into the zero value "", indistinguishable from an
306	// omitted member or an explicitly written empty string: an artifact with a
307	// legal name and "source":null and no rules that need the ABI or bytecode
308	// would then hash exactly like one whose source was submitted as "", pass
309	// every business check and receive a success report, laundering a malformed
310	// submission into a legal one. Whenever a formal member is present its value
311	// must therefore be a JSON string — null, a boolean, a number, an object or
312	// an array rejects the whole submission, independently of the rules array,
313	// the check records and of whether any rule references the field. The check
314	// is about the JSON type alone, not non-empty text: an omitted member still
315	// decodes to its default and an explicit "" keeps the ordinary business
316	// judgement (an empty name still produces no report, a rule that needs an
317	// ABI still needs a non-empty one, a symbolic rule still needs non-empty
318	// bytecode, and legal empty text is otherwise accepted). The strict rewrite
319	// dropped extension members, so a case-variant or whitespace-padded name
320	// ("Source", " source ") neither fills a missing formal field nor rescues an
321	// illegal formal value; names written with Unicode escapes are compared
322	// after decoding, so "source":null names the same formal source field.
323	// The error names the exact field, e.g. "artifact.source". An absent or null
324	// artifact object is left untouched here: the existing "artifact name is
325	// required" business error keeps covering it.
326	func validateFormalArtifactFields(strict []byte) error {
327		var top struct {
328			Artifact json.RawMessage `json:"artifact"`
329		}
330		if err := json.Unmarshal(strict, &top); err != nil {
331			return errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
332		}
333		if len(top.Artifact) == 0 || string(top.Artifact) == "null" {
334			return nil
335		}
336		var artifact map[string]json.RawMessage
337		if err := json.Unmarshal(top.Artifact, &artifact); err != nil {
338			return errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
339		}
340		for _, field := range artifactTextFields {
341			raw, present := artifact[field]
342			if !present {
343				continue
344			}
345			var token any
346			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &token); err != nil {
347				return errInvalid("artifact." + field + " must be a string")
348			}
349			if _, ok := token.(string); !ok {
350				return errInvalid("artifact." + field + " must be a string")
351			}
352		}
353		return nil
354	}

356	// ParseAuditInput decodes an audit submission JSON object into domain values.
357	// Invariant values must be JSON booleans; any other type is an error. A formal
358	// requiresABI member on a rule must likewise be a JSON boolean: null or any
359	// non-boolean value rejects the whole submission instead of being read as the
360	// zero value false, while an omitted member still means false. Each formal
361	// rule text member (id, kind, severity, invariant, version), each formal
362	// artifact member (name, abi, bytecode, source) and the formal note member of
363	// each check record that is written out must be a JSON string: null or any
364	// non-string value rejects the whole submission instead of being read as the
365	// zero value "", while an omitted member still takes its default and an
366	// explicit empty string keeps the ordinary business judgement. Any JSON
367	// object in the submission that repeats a member name
368	// rejects the whole submission: the decoder keeps only the last value
369	// silently, so a repeated invariant key would choose a conclusion by member
370	// order instead of giving one trustworthy result. A character the decoder
371	// would silently rewrite — an invalid UTF-8 byte, or an unpaired or wrongly
372	// ordered surrogate escape in any member name or string value, including
373	// values nested under unknown extension members — rejects the whole
374	// submission as an input error before any content is hashed, so evidence and
375	// hashes always reflect the submitted bytes rather than a U+FFFD-rewritten
376	// copy. Only the fixed fields under their agreed spelling participate: case
377	// variants and whitespace-padded names are extension data and are ignored, so
378	// they can neither override a formal value nor supply one when the formal
379	// member is missing or unsupported. Invariant names are not fixed fields —
380	// they are user-defined, compared case sensitively and never trimmed.
381	func ParseAuditInput(data []byte) (Artifact, []Rule, map[string]bool, []CheckRecord, error) {
382		if charErr := validateJSONCharacters(data); charErr != nil {
383			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid(charErr.Error())
384		}
385		if dup := findDuplicateJSONMember(data); dup != nil {
386			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid(duplicateMemberMessage(data, dup))
387		}
388		strict, err := strictSubmissionJSON(data)
389		if err != nil {
390			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
391		}
392		if err := validateFormalCheckStatuses(strict); err != nil {
393			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
394		}
395		if err := validateFormalCheckNotes(strict); err != nil {
396			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
397		}
398		if err := validateFormalRequiresABI(strict); err != nil {
399			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
400		}
401		if err := validateFormalRuleText(strict); err != nil {
402			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
403		}
404		if err := validateFormalArtifactFields(strict); err != nil {
405			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, err
406		}
407		var in wireInput
408		if err := json.Unmarshal(strict, &in); err != nil {
409			return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invalid JSON: " + err.Error())
410		}
411		invariants := make(map[string]bool, len(in.Invariants))
412		for key, raw := range in.Invariants {
413			// Only JSON true/false is a conclusion. Unmarshalling directly into a
414			// bool would turn null into the zero value false, which would falsely
415			// record a defect; require the token to be a boolean instead.
416			var token any
417			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &token); err != nil {
418				return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invariant " + key + " must be a boolean")
419			}
420			holds, ok := token.(bool)
421			if !ok {
422				return Artifact{}, nil, nil, nil, errInvalid("invariant " + key + " must be a boolean")
423			}
424			invariants[key] = holds
425		}
426		artifact := Artifact{
427			Name:     in.Artifact.Name,
428			ABI:      in.Artifact.ABI,
429			Bytecode: in.Artifact.Bytecode,
430			Source:   in.Artifact.Source,
431		}
432		rules := make([]Rule, 0, len(in.Rules))
433		for _, wr := range in.Rules {
434			rules = append(rules, Rule{
435				ID:          wr.ID,
436				Kind:        wr.Kind,
437				Severity:    wr.Severity,
438				Invariant:   wr.Invariant,
439				RequiresABI: wr.RequiresABI,
440				Version:     wr.Version,
441			})
442		}
443		checks := make([]CheckRecord, 0, len(in.Checks))
444		for _, wc := range in.Checks {
445			checks = append(checks, CheckRecord{
446				ArtifactHash: wc.ArtifactHash,
447				RuleID:       wc.RuleID,
448				Version:      wc.Version,
449				Status:       wc.Status,
450				Note:         wc.Note,
451			})
452		}
453		return artifact, rules, invariants, checks, nil
454	}

456	// ArtifactHash computes the content hash of an artifact. Only the raw ABI,
457	// bytecode and source strings contribute; field boundaries are explicit
458	// (length-prefixed) so that different splits never collide. The source is
459	// hashed as a field value, never read from disk, and the name does not
460	// participate.
461	func ArtifactHash(a Artifact) string {
462		h := sha256.New()
463		h.Write([]byte("contractsentinel-artifact-v1\n"))
464		for _, field := range []string{a.ABI, a.Bytecode, a.Source} {
465			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d\n", len(field))
466			h.Write([]byte(field))
467		}
468		sum := h.Sum(nil)
469		return hex.EncodeToString(sum)
470	}

472	// validCheckStatus reports whether status is one of the four recorded check
473	// conclusions.
474	func validCheckStatus(status string) bool {
475		switch status {
476		case StatusPass, StatusDefect, StatusToolMissing, StatusTimeout:
477			return true
478		}
479		return false
480	}

482	// BuildReport evaluates rules against the artifact and invariant values and
483	// imported check records and produces the report to persist. Insufficient
484	// inputs (missing ABI for a rule that requires it, missing bytecode for a
485	// symbolic rule) fail the whole submission and are never recorded as defects.
486	// Imported checks are validated as a whole: unknown rules, duplicate records,
487	// unknown statuses, missing notes, hash or version mismatches, and a rule
488	// receiving both a check record and an invariant boolean all reject the
489	// submission without producing a report.
490	func BuildReport(artifact Artifact, rules []Rule, invariants map[string]bool, checks []CheckRecord) (Report, error) {
491		if artifact.Name == "" {
492			return Report{}, errInvalid("artifact name is required")
493		}
494		hash := ArtifactHash(artifact)
495		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(rules))
496		ruleByID := make(map[string]Rule, len(rules))
497		for _, rule := range rules {
498			if rule.ID == "" {
499				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule id is required")
500			}
501			if rule.Version == "" {
502				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " version is required")
503			}
504			if seen[rule.ID] {
505				return Report{}, errInvalid("duplicate rule id " + rule.ID)
506			}
507			seen[rule.ID] = true
508			ruleByID[rule.ID] = rule
509			if rule.RequiresABI && artifact.ABI == "" {
510				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " requires an ABI")
511			}
512			if rule.Kind == "symbolic" && artifact.Bytecode == "" {
513				return Report{}, errInvalid("symbolic rule " + rule.ID + " requires bytecode")
514			}
515		}
516		checkByRule := make(map[string]CheckRecord, len(checks))
517		for _, check := range checks {
518			if check.RuleID == "" {
519				return Report{}, errInvalid("check rule id is required")
520			}
521			rule, ok := ruleByID[check.RuleID]
522			if !ok {
523				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": unknown rule")
524			}
525			if _, dup := checkByRule[check.RuleID]; dup {
526				return Report{}, errInvalid("duplicate check for rule " + check.RuleID)
527			}
528			if check.ArtifactHash != hash {
529				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": artifact hash mismatch")
530			}
531			if check.Version != rule.Version {
532				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": version mismatch")
533			}
534			if !validCheckStatus(check.Status) {
535				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": unknown status " + check.Status)
536			}
537			if check.Status != StatusPass && strings.TrimSpace(check.Note) == "" {
538				return Report{}, errInvalid("check for rule " + check.RuleID + ": note is required for status " + check.Status)
539			}
540			if _, hasInvariant := invariants[rule.Invariant]; hasInvariant {
541				return Report{}, errInvalid("rule " + check.RuleID + ": both a check record and an invariant value are provided")
542			}
543			checkByRule[check.RuleID] = check
544		}
545		report := Report{
546			Artifact: ReportArtifact{Name: artifact.Name, Hash: hash},
547			Rules:    []ReportRule{},
548			Findings: []ReportFinding{},
549		}
550		for _, rule := range rules {
551			status := StatusUnchecked
552			note := ""
553			if check, ok := checkByRule[rule.ID]; ok {
554				status = check.Status
555				note = check.Note
556			} else {
557				// No imported check: the invariant booleans decide. The verdict
558				// interpretation is shared with the finding-list path in Run.
559				switch checkInvariant(rule, invariants) {
560				case invariantHolds:
561					status = StatusPass
562				case invariantViolated:
563					status = StatusDefect
564				}
565			}
566			report.Rules = append(report.Rules, ReportRule{
567				ID:          rule.ID,
568				Kind:        rule.Kind,
569				Severity:    rule.Severity,
570				Invariant:   rule.Invariant,
571				RequiresABI: rule.RequiresABI,
572				Version:     rule.Version,
573				Status:      status,
574				Note:        note,
575			})
576			if status == StatusDefect {
577				evidence := note
578				if evidence == "" {
579					evidence = invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)
580				}
581				report.Findings = append(report.Findings, ReportFinding{
582					ArtifactHash: hash,
583					RuleID:       rule.ID,
584					Version:      rule.Version,
585					Severity:     rule.Severity,
586					Invariant:    rule.Invariant,
587					Evidence:     evidence,
588				})
589			}
590		}
591		report.ReportID = ReportID(report)
592		return report, nil
593	}
594	
595	// canonicalReport is the deterministic content a report id is computed from.
596	// The rules and findings are the report's own ReportRule and ReportFinding
597	// values: their stored JSON fields are exactly the content the id binds, so
598	// the id form reuses the one field representation instead of maintaining a
599	// parallel copy that every field change would have to be mirrored into. The
600	// rule note keeps its omitempty behaviour, so a note omitted and a note
601	// written as an empty string hash alike and reports built only from invariant
602	// booleans keep their original ids.
603	type canonicalReport struct {
604		ArtifactHash string          `json:"artifactHash"`
605		Name         string          `json:"name"`
606		Rules        []ReportRule    `json:"rules"`
607		Findings     []ReportFinding `json:"findings"`
608	}
609	
610	// canonicalize renders a report into its order-independent form. The rule and
611	// finding slices are copied before sorting, so computing an id never reorders
612	// the report itself: a saved report keeps the submission order and a loaded
613	// report keeps the archive order.
614	func canonicalize(report Report) canonicalReport {
615		cr := canonicalReport{
616			ArtifactHash: report.Artifact.Hash,
617			Name:         report.Artifact.Name,
618		}
619		cr.Rules = append(cr.Rules, report.Rules...)
620		sort.Slice(cr.Rules, func(i, j int) bool { return cr.Rules[i].ID < cr.Rules[j].ID })
621		cr.Findings = append(cr.Findings, report.Findings...)
622		sort.Slice(cr.Findings, func(i, j int) bool { return cr.Findings[i].RuleID < cr.Findings[j].RuleID })
623		return cr
624	}
625	
626	// ReportID returns the content-addressed identifier of a report. The id binds
627	// the artifact hash, name, complete rule definitions, the invariant value
628	// used by each rule (unchecked and explicit pass are distinct), and the
629	// findings. Rule order, invariant key order and unrelated invariant keys do
630	// not influence it.
631	func ReportID(r Report) string {
632		data, err := json.Marshal(canonicalize(r))
633		if err != nil {
634			panic(err) // canonical values are all strings and bools
635		}
636		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
637		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
638	}
639	
640	// validateReport checks every archive legality condition against r. It is the
641	// single definition of a legal report: the id and artifact hash are 64
642	// lowercase hex characters, the id matches the content, the artifact name is
643	// present, rule ids are present and unique with non-empty versions, statuses
644	// use the five recorded values, tool-missing and timeout notes are
645	// non-blank, a 发现缺陷 rule never carries a note that is present yet entirely
646	// whitespace (an omitted or empty note stays legal for the invariant-boolean
647	// evidence form), and 发现缺陷 rules correspond one-to-one with findings whose
648	// artifact hash, version, severity, invariant and evidence match the rule.
649	// The same conditions apply to submissions and to stored archives: a
650	// recomputed id never makes an invalid report legal. fail is errInvalid for
651	// submissions and errCorrupt for stored archives.
652	func validateReport(r Report, fail func(string) error) error {
653		if !validReportID(r.ReportID) {
654			return fail("report id " + r.ReportID + " is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
655		}
656		if r.Artifact.Name == "" {
657			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact name is required")
658		}
659		if !validReportID(r.Artifact.Hash) {
660			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact hash is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
661		}
662		if ReportID(r) != r.ReportID {
663			return fail("report content does not match id " + r.ReportID)
664		}
665		seenRule := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Rules))
666		defectByID := make(map[string]ReportRule)
667		for _, rule := range r.Rules {
668			if rule.ID == "" {
669				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a rule with an empty id")
670			}
671			if seenRule[rule.ID] {
672				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has duplicate rule id " + rule.ID)
673			}
674			seenRule[rule.ID] = true
675			if rule.Version == "" {
676				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has an empty version")
677			}
678			switch rule.Status {
679			case StatusUnchecked, StatusPass, StatusDefect, StatusToolMissing, StatusTimeout:
680			default:
681				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has unknown status " + rule.Status)
682			}
683			if (rule.Status == StatusToolMissing || rule.Status == StatusTimeout) && strings.TrimSpace(rule.Note) == "" {
684				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " status " + rule.Status + " has no note")
685			}
686			if rule.Status == StatusDefect {
687				// A defect rule may carry no note at all (reports built only from
688				// invariant booleans, whose finding holds the generated evidence),
689				// but a note that is present yet entirely whitespace is not a
690				// checker description: the blankness judgement is the same
691				// TrimSpace one the audit submission applies. The evidence matching
692				// the note verbatim and the recomputed id matching the content can
693				// never make such a note legal, and the whole report is rejected
694				// rather than skipping the bad rule.
695				if rule.Note != "" && strings.TrimSpace(rule.Note) == "" {
696					return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " status " + rule.Status + " has a blank note")
697				}
698				defectByID[rule.ID] = rule
699			}
700		}
701		seenFinding := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Findings))
702		for _, f := range r.Findings {
703			if f.RuleID == "" {
704				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a finding with an empty rule id")
705			}
706			rule, ok := defectByID[f.RuleID]
707			if !ok {
708				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " does not match a 发现缺陷 rule")
709			}
710			if seenFinding[f.RuleID] {
711				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a duplicate finding for rule " + f.RuleID)
712			}
713			seenFinding[f.RuleID] = true
714			if f.ArtifactHash != r.Artifact.Hash {
715				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has artifact hash " + f.ArtifactHash + ", want " + r.Artifact.Hash)
716			}
717			if f.Version != rule.Version {
718				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has version " + f.Version + ", want " + rule.Version)
719			}
720			if f.Severity != rule.Severity {
721				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has severity " + f.Severity + ", want " + rule.Severity)
722			}
723			if f.Invariant != rule.Invariant {
724				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has invariant " + f.Invariant + ", want " + rule.Invariant)
725			}
726			wantEvidence := rule.Note
727			if wantEvidence == "" {
728				wantEvidence = invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)
729			}
730			if f.Evidence != wantEvidence {
731				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has evidence " + f.Evidence + ", want " + wantEvidence)
732			}
733		}
734		for id := range defectByID {
735			if !seenFinding[id] {
736				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " defect rule " + id + " has no finding")
737			}
738		}
739		return nil
740	}

752	// firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString returns the first byte that is not valid UTF-8
753	// inside s. A Go string can carry any bytes, including bytes no JSON text may
754	// contain: json.Marshal (and therefore the canonical marshalling inside
755	// ReportID) silently replaces such a byte with U+FFFD instead of failing, so
756	// neither the id/content check nor the archive round trip can see it.
757	func firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(s string) (byte, bool) {
758		for i := 0; i < len(s); {
759			r, size := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(s[i:])
760			if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
761				return s[i], true
762			}
763			i += size
764		}
765		return 0, false
766	}
767	
768	// validateSubmittedText is the in-memory counterpart of the JSON character
769	// gates in ParseAuditInput and loadStoredReport. SaveReport accepts a Report
770	// built directly by a Go caller, whose strings never passed through JSON
771	// decoding; encoding/json marshals such a value without an error while
772	// replacing every invalid UTF-8 byte with U+FFFD, and ReportID computes from
773	// the same rewritten canonical form, so the recomputed id and the
774	// rule/finding correspondence would all match an archive whose text no
775	// longer equals what the caller handed over. Every caller-supplied string is
776	// therefore checked on the raw object — reportId, artifact name and hash,
777	// each rule definition field and status note, and each finding binding field
778	// and evidence — independently of which rules produced defects and of
779	// whether the report carries any finding at all. The rejection is an input
780	// error naming the exact field, with the array position of rules and
781	// findings, and it runs before any filesystem operation.
782	func validateSubmittedText(r Report) error {
783		check := func(field, value string) error {
784			if b, bad := firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(value); bad {
785				return errInvalid(fmt.Sprintf("invalid UTF-8 byte 0x%02x in report field %s", b, field))
786			}
787			return nil
788		}
789		if err := check("reportId", r.ReportID); err != nil {
790			return err
791		}
792		if err := check("artifact.name", r.Artifact.Name); err != nil {
793			return err
794		}
795		if err := check("artifact.hash", r.Artifact.Hash); err != nil {
796			return err
797		}
798		ruleFields := []string{"id", "kind", "severity", "invariant", "version", "status", "note"}
799		for i, rule := range r.Rules {
800			values := []string{rule.ID, rule.Kind, rule.Severity, rule.Invariant, rule.Version, rule.Status, rule.Note}
801			for j, value := range values {
802				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("rules[%d].%s", i, ruleFields[j]), value); err != nil {
803					return err
804				}
805			}
806		}
807		findingFields := []string{"artifactHash", "ruleId", "version", "severity", "invariant", "evidence"}
808		for i, finding := range r.Findings {
809			values := []string{finding.ArtifactHash, finding.RuleID, finding.Version, finding.Severity, finding.Invariant, finding.Evidence}
810			for j, value := range values {
811				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("findings[%d].%s", i, findingFields[j]), value); err != nil {
812					return err
813				}
814			}
815		}
816		return nil
817	}
818	
819	// duplicateArchiveError classifies an archive that repeats a JSON member as
820	// corrupt and names the requested report id, the decoded member name and the
821	// object carrying it (with array position and rule id when applicable).
822	func duplicateArchiveError(id string, data []byte, dup *duplicateMemberError) error {
823		return errCorrupt("report " + id + " archive is corrupt: " + duplicateMemberMessage(data, dup))
824	}
825	
826	// characterArchiveError classifies an archive whose bytes are not legal JSON
827	// text — an invalid UTF-8 byte anywhere, or an unpaired / wrongly ordered
828	// surrogate escape inside any member name or string value, including unknown
829	// extension members — as corrupt and names the requested report id together
830	// with the precise byte offset, line/column and JSON path. It is the
831	// read-side counterpart of the submission gate in ParseAuditInput: the decode
832	// below would otherwise replace both problems with U+FFFD and could accept a
833	// rewritten archive whose id and rule/finding evidence happened to match.
834	func characterArchiveError(id string, charErr *charEncodingError) error {
835		return errCorrupt("report " + id + " archive is corrupt: " + charErr.Error())
836	}
837	
838	// reportShape is the fixed-field shape of a stored report archive: the agreed
839	// spellings at the top level and inside the artifact, every rule and every
840	// finding. The trusted content of a report is carried by these fixed fields
841	// alone; case variants, whitespace-padded names and unknown members are
842	// extension data and never reach the decoder.
843	var reportShape = fixedShape{
844		keys: []string{"reportId", "artifact", "rules", "findings"},
845		objects: map[string]fixedShape{
846			"artifact": {keys: []string{"name", "hash"}},
847		},
848		arrays: map[string]fixedShape{
849			"rules":    {keys: []string{"id", "kind", "severity", "invariant", "requiresABI", "version", "status", "note"}},
850			"findings": {keys: []string{"artifactHash", "ruleId", "version", "severity", "invariant", "evidence"}},
851		},
852	}
853	
854	// strictReportJSON rewrites archive bytes to the fixed report fields under
855	// their original spelling; see fixedShape for the recognition convention
856	// shared with the submission side.
857	func strictReportJSON(data []byte) ([]byte, error) {
858		return strictFixedJSON(data, reportShape)
859	}

861	// validateArchiveRuleFields is the read-side counterpart of the submission
862	// gate in validateFormalRequiresABI. A ReportRule's typed members are Go
863	// bool/string fields, so decoding the strict archive straight into Report
864	// turns a formal null member into the zero value false or "": an archive that
865	// wrote "requiresABI":null, or "note":null on a passing rule without a note,
866	// would read byte-for-byte like one that omitted the member, the recomputed
867	// id and the rule/finding correspondence would all pass on that laundered
868	// value, and a diff could even compare the rule as unchanged. The shared
869	// checkObjectArrayFieldTypes gate therefore inspects each written formal
870	// member's raw JSON token before that decoding happens. null or any other
871	// non-required type makes the whole archive corrupt, independently of the
872	// rule's check status and of whether it has a finding — the offending rule is
873	// never skipped and no partial report is returned. An omitted member still
874	// decodes to the zero value and an explicit empty string is still judged by
875	// the ordinary business rules: the string gate is about the JSON type alone,
876	// not about requiring text to be non-empty. The strict rewrite dropped
877	// extension members, so a case-variant or whitespace-padded name is invisible
878	// here: a correctly typed value it carries neither supplies nor rescues the
879	// formal value, and a null it carries never reaches this gate. locate renders
880	// the rule locator in the wording each gate historically used, and every
881	// error names the requested report id and is classified as archive
882	// corruption.
883	func validateArchiveRuleFields(strict []byte, id string, checks []ruleFieldTypeCheck,
884		locate func(int, map[string]json.RawMessage) string) error {
885		return validateArchiveArrayFields(strict, id, "rules", checks, locate)
886	}
887	
888	// validateArchiveArrayFields runs the raw-token type gate for one top-level
889	// fixed-shape object array of a stored report archive ("rules" or
890	// "findings"); the written-means-typed rule and the error classification are
891	// identical on both arrays and live in this single wrapper.
892	func validateArchiveArrayFields(strict []byte, id, arrayName string, checks []ruleFieldTypeCheck,
893		locate func(int, map[string]json.RawMessage) string) error {
894		return checkObjectArrayFieldTypes(strict, arrayName, checks, ruleFieldTypeHooks{
895			locate: locate,
896			invalidJSON: func(err error) error {
897				return errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
898			},
899			reject: func(where, field string, typ ruleFieldType) error {
900				return errCorrupt("report " + id + " archive is corrupt: " + where + ": " + field + " " + typ.requirement())
901			},
902		})
903	}
904	
905	// archiveRuleLocator names a rule in an archive error by its formal id
906	// ("rule r-bad"), falling back to "rule" when the id is missing, empty or not
907	// itself a legal string. It deliberately carries no rules-array position.
908	func archiveRuleLocator(_ int, rule map[string]json.RawMessage) string {
909		if ruleID := formalRuleID(rule); ruleID != "" {
910			return "rule " + ruleID
911		}
912		return "rule"
913	}
914	
915	// archiveRulePositionLocator names a rule's position in the rules array
916	// ("rules[1]") and, when the rule carries a legal non-empty id, also names it
917	// ("rules[1] (rule r-bad)").
918	func archiveRulePositionLocator(i int, rule map[string]json.RawMessage) string {
919		where := fmt.Sprintf("rules[%d]", i)
920		if ruleID := formalRuleID(rule); ruleID != "" {
921			where += " (rule " + ruleID + ")"
922		}
923		return where
924	}
925	
926	// validateArchiveRequiresABI runs the read-side boolean gate for the formal
927	// requiresABI member.
928	func validateArchiveRequiresABI(strict []byte, id string) error {
929		return validateArchiveRuleFields(strict, id,
930			[]ruleFieldTypeCheck{{field: "requiresABI", typ: ruleFieldBoolean}},
931			archiveRuleLocator)
932	}
933	
934	// archiveRuleTextFields lists the formal rule members whose value, once the
935	// member is written out, must be a JSON string.
936	var archiveRuleTextFields = []string{"id", "kind", "severity", "invariant", "version", "status", "note"}
937	
938	// validateArchiveRuleText runs the read-side string gate for the text fields
939	// of every stored rule; see validateArchiveRuleFields for why the raw token is
940	// checked before decoding.
941	func validateArchiveRuleText(strict []byte, id string) error {
942		checks := make([]ruleFieldTypeCheck, len(archiveRuleTextFields))
943		for i, field := range archiveRuleTextFields {
944			checks[i] = ruleFieldTypeCheck{field: field, typ: ruleFieldString}
945		}
946		return validateArchiveRuleFields(strict, id, checks, archiveRulePositionLocator)
947	}
948	
949	// archiveFindingTextFields lists the six formal finding members whose value,
950	// once the member is written out in a stored report archive, must be a JSON
951	// string.
952	var archiveFindingTextFields = []string{"artifactHash", "ruleId", "version", "severity", "invariant", "evidence"}
953	
954	// archiveFindingPositionLocator names a finding's zero-based position in the
955	// findings array ("findings[1]") and, when the record carries a legal
956	// non-empty ruleId, also names the rule it belongs to
957	// ("findings[1] (rule r-bad)"); a missing, empty or mistyped ruleId leaves
958	// the record locatable by position alone.
959	func archiveFindingPositionLocator(i int, rec map[string]json.RawMessage) string {
960		where := fmt.Sprintf("findings[%d]", i)
961		if ruleID := formalFindingRuleID(rec); ruleID != "" {
962			where += " (rule " + ruleID + ")"
963		}
964		return where
965	}

967	// validateArchiveFindingText runs the read-side string gate for the text
968	// fields of every stored finding; see validateArchiveRuleFields for why the
969	// raw token is checked before decoding. A ReportFinding's members are all Go
970	// strings, so decoding a finding straight from the strict archive turns a
971	// formal null member into the zero value "": a legal report whose rule and
972	// finding both carry the empty string for severity (or invariant) could have
973	// the finding's member rewritten to null and still read back byte-identical —
974	// the artifact hash, the report id and the rule/finding correspondence all
975	// agree on that laundered empty text, and a later diff could even show
976	// 无变化. Whenever one of the six formal members is present its value must
977	// therefore be a JSON string — null, a boolean, a number, an object or an
978	// array rejects the whole archive even when every binding still matches; the
979	// offending finding is never skipped and no partial report is returned. The
980	// gate is about the JSON type alone, not non-empty text: an omitted member
981	// still decodes to "" and an explicit empty string keeps the ordinary
982	// required-field and binding judgement, so legal empty severity and invariant
983	// text stays legal. Extension names are invisible here for the same reason as
984	// on rules.
985	func validateArchiveFindingText(strict []byte, id string) error {
986		checks := make([]ruleFieldTypeCheck, len(archiveFindingTextFields))
987		for i, field := range archiveFindingTextFields {
988			checks[i] = ruleFieldTypeCheck{field: field, typ: ruleFieldString}
989		}
990		return validateArchiveArrayFields(strict, id, "findings", checks, archiveFindingPositionLocator)
991	}

993	// loadStoredReport parses archive bytes for id and fully validates them.
994	func loadStoredReport(data []byte, id string) (Report, error) {
995		// Read-side counterpart of the submission character gate in
996		// ParseAuditInput. As with a repeated member, json.Unmarshal silently
997		// rewrites an invalid UTF-8 byte and an unpaired or wrongly ordered
998		// surrogate escape into U+FFFD, so an archive whose note and evidence both
999		// carried the substitution character could have those two spots changed to
1000		// lone surrogate escapes and still decode to byte-identical content: the
1001		// recomputed id and the rule/finding evidence comparison would then pass on
1002		// the rewritten copy. Every raw string literal is checked first — member
1003		// names and values, at every depth, inside unknown extension members too —
1004		// and the whole archive is corrupt when any character is illegal, whatever
1005		// id the rewritten content would compute.
1006		if charErr := validateJSONCharacters(data); charErr != nil {
1007			return Report{}, characterArchiveError(id, charErr)
1008		}
1009		// Read-side counterpart of the submission check: json.Unmarshal silently
1010		// keeps the last value for a repeated member, so an archive that writes a
1011		// rule status as 发现缺陷 and then 通过 would decode to whichever came
1012		// last. The recomputed id and the rule/finding correspondence all operate
1013		// on that last-wins value and could therefore pass, accepting an archive
1014		// with two conflicting conclusions. Any repeated member in any object
1015		// makes the archive corrupt, regardless of the last value.
1016		if dup := findDuplicateJSONMember(data); dup != nil {
1017			return Report{}, duplicateArchiveError(id, data, dup)
1018		}
1019		strict, err := strictReportJSON(data)
1020		if err != nil {
1021			return Report{}, errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
1022		}
1023		// Check the formal requiresABI member against its raw JSON token before
1024		// decoding into the Go bool below; otherwise a null value would silently
1025		// become the zero value false and could pass every later check, including
1026		// the content id, as if the archive had explicitly said false.
1027		if err := validateArchiveRequiresABI(strict, id); err != nil {
1028			return Report{}, err
1029		}
1030		// Same laundering hazard for the rule text fields: decoding into a Go
1031		// string turns a formal null member into "", so an archive that wrote
1032		// "note":null on a note-less passing rule would pass every later check,
1033		// including the content id, as if the member had been omitted. Check the
1034		// raw JSON token of every written formal text member before decoding.
1035		if err := validateArchiveRuleText(strict, id); err != nil {
1036			return Report{}, err
1037		}
1038		// Same hazard on the findings array, where every member is a Go string:
1039		// a finding written with "severity":null or "invariant":null decodes to
1040		// the empty string and, in a report whose rule carries that same empty
1041		// text, passes the id and every rule/finding binding as if the archive
1042		// had saved the legal empty text; diffs could then read 无变化 from text
1043		// the archive never contained. Check the raw JSON token of every written
1044		// finding text member before decoding into ReportFinding.
1045		if err := validateArchiveFindingText(strict, id); err != nil {
1046			return Report{}, err
1047		}
1048		var r Report
1049		if err := json.Unmarshal(strict, &r); err != nil {
1050			return Report{}, errCorrupt("invalid JSON in report " + id + ": " + err.Error())
1051		}
1052		if r.ReportID != id {
1053			return Report{}, errCorrupt("report id " + r.ReportID + " does not match requested id " + id)
1054		}
1055		if err := validStoredReport(r); err != nil {
1056			return Report{}, err
1057		}
1058		return r, nil
1059	}

1061	// saveReportHook, when set, is invoked after the archive existence check and
1062	// before the atomic publish. It lets tests simulate another process racing to
1063	// claim the same report id.
1064	var saveReportHook func(finalPath string)

1066	// SaveReport persists a report under the store directory. The store is safe
1067	// for concurrent writers: identical reports share one file and all
1068	// submissions succeed, different reports never overwrite each other, and
1069	// readers only ever observe complete files. A submission is fully validated
1070	// before any store operation, so an invalid report creates no store and no
1071	// files. Every string in a directly constructed report must be valid UTF-8:
1072	// json.Marshal would otherwise rewrite an invalid byte to U+FFFD while the
1073	// content-addressed id matched the rewritten copy, reporting success for an
1074	// archive whose text differs from the caller's; such a report is rejected as
1075	// an input error before the store directory is touched. A pre-existing file
1076	// with the same id must be a valid archive of the same report; a corrupted
1077	// archive makes the submission fail while keeping the original file, even
1078	// when the corruption appears only during the save. The first successfully
1079	// archived bytes are never replaced by later submissions.
1080	func SaveReport(dir string, r Report) error {
1081		if err := validateSubmittedText(r); err != nil {
1082			return err
1083		}
1084		if err := validSubmittedReport(r); err != nil {
1085			return err
1086		}
1087		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
1088			return err
1089		}
1090		finalPath := filepath.Join(dir, r.ReportID+".json")
1091		if existing, err := os.ReadFile(finalPath); err == nil {
1092			if _, err := loadStoredReport(existing, r.ReportID); err != nil {
1093				return err
1094			}
1095			return nil
1096		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1097			return err
1098		}
1099		data, err := json.Marshal(r)
1100		if err != nil {
1101			return err
1102		}
1103		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".report-*.tmp")
1104		if err != nil {
1105			return err
1106		}
1107		tmpPath := tmp.Name()
1108		cleanup := func() { os.Remove(tmpPath) }
1109		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
1110			tmp.Close()
1111			cleanup()
1112			return err
1113		}
1114		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
1115			tmp.Close()
1116			cleanup()
1117			return err
1118		}
1119		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1120			cleanup()
1121			return err
1122		}
1123		if saveReportHook != nil {
1124			saveReportHook(finalPath)
1125		}
1126		if err := os.Link(tmpPath, finalPath); err != nil {
1127			cleanup()
1128			if os.IsExist(err) {
1129				existing, readErr := os.ReadFile(finalPath)
1130				if readErr != nil {
1131					return readErr
1132				}
1133				if _, err := loadStoredReport(existing, r.ReportID); err != nil {
1134					return err
1135				}
1136				return nil
1137			}
1138			return err
1139		}
1140		cleanup()
1141		return nil
1142	}

1144	// LoadReport reads and verifies a report by id. The id must be 64 lowercase
1145	// hex characters; missing, corrupted or tampered archives produce a clear
1146	// error. The store is only read, never created or modified.
1147	func LoadReport(dir, id string) (Report, error) {
1148		if !validReportID(id) {
1149			return Report{}, errInvalid("invalid report id " + id + ": want 64 lowercase hex characters")
1150		}
1151		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, id+".json"))
1152		if err != nil {
1153			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
1154				return Report{}, errNotFound("report " + id + " not found")
1155			}
1156			return Report{}, err
1157		}
1158		return loadStoredReport(data, id)
1159	}

1	// Package contractsentinel implements audit rule evaluation over contract artifacts.
2	package contractsentinel
3	
4	import "sort"
5	
6	// Artifact is one compiled contract target under audit.
7	type Artifact struct {
8		Name     string
9		ABI      string
10		Bytecode string
11		Source   string
12	}
13	
14	// Finding is one rule violation with the invariant it breaks.
15	type Finding struct {
16		Rule      string
17		Severity  string
18		Invariant string
19		Evidence  string
20	}
21	
22	// Rule is a static or symbolic check the pipeline can run.
23	type Rule struct {
24		ID          string
25		Kind        string
26		Severity    string
27		Invariant   string
28		RequiresABI bool
29		Version     string
30	}
31	
32	// invariantVerdict is the conclusion the submitted invariant booleans give
33	// one rule. Only a boolean carried under the rule's own invariant name
34	// counts, and only false is a defect: true and absent are distinct
35	// conclusions (the report path records them as 通过 and 未检查), and neither
36	// produces a finding.
37	type invariantVerdict int
38	
39	const (
40		invariantUnchecked invariantVerdict = iota // no value provided for the rule's invariant
41		invariantHolds                             // the invariant was checked and holds
42		invariantViolated                          // the invariant was checked and does not hold
43	)
44	
45	// checkInvariant is the single interpretation of invariant booleans shared by
46	// the finding-list and the report paths, so the judgement rules live in one
47	// place. Invariant names are user-defined: they are looked up exactly as the
48	// rule carries them, case and whitespace included.
49	func checkInvariant(rule Rule, invariants map[string]bool) invariantVerdict {
50		holds, checked := invariants[rule.Invariant]
51		switch {
52		case !checked:
53			return invariantUnchecked
54		case holds:
55			return invariantHolds
56		default:
57			return invariantViolated
58		}
59	}
60	
61	// invariantEvidence is the defect evidence for a violated invariant. The name
62	// is the rule's original value: case, whitespace and punctuation are kept as
63	// written.
64	func invariantEvidence(invariant string) string {
65		return "invariant " + invariant + " does not hold"
66	}
67	
68	// Run executes the deterministic subset of rules and refuses inputs they need.
69	func Run(artifact Artifact, rules []Rule, invariants map[string]bool) ([]Finding, error) {
70		if artifact.Name == "" {
71			return nil, errInvalid("artifact name is required")
72		}
73		var findings []Finding
74		for _, rule := range rules {
75			if rule.RequiresABI && artifact.ABI == "" {
76				return nil, errInvalid("rule " + rule.ID + " needs an ABI")
77			}
78			if rule.Kind == "symbolic" && artifact.Bytecode == "" {
79				return nil, errInvalid("symbolic rule " + rule.ID + " needs bytecode")
80			}
81			if checkInvariant(rule, invariants) == invariantViolated {
82				findings = append(findings, Finding{Rule: rule.ID, Severity: rule.Severity,
83					Invariant: rule.Invariant, Evidence: invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)})
84			}
85		}
86		sort.Slice(findings, func(i, j int) bool {
87			if findings[i].Severity == findings[j].Severity {
88				return findings[i].Rule < findings[j].Rule
89			}
90			return findings[i].Severity > findings[j].Severity
91		})
92		return findings, nil
93	}
94

96	
97	func (e errInvalid) Error() string { return string(e) }

661	## 比较两份已保存的报告（diff）
662	
663	`diff` 从**同一个报告目录**中读取两份已经落盘的报告，逐规则比较并输出确定性的比较 JSON（无时间戳，重复比较同一对报告结果逐字节一致）。
664	
665	```bash
666	go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
667	  --store ./reports \
668	  --before <基准报告 reportId> \
669	  --after <新报告 reportId>
670	```
671	
672	`./cs diff ...` 与上面的 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff ...` 等价，全程离线。
673	
674	三个参数各选什么：
675	
676	- **`--store`**：两份报告共同所在的报告目录，与 `audit`、`report` 用的是同一个目录参数。
677	- **`--before`**：基准报告（当作对照的较早一次审计）；**`--after`**：新报告。
678	- **比较方向只由两个标识所在的参数位置决定**：工具不按文件时间或归档顺序猜测方向。交换两个参数，所有“新发现/已消除”的方向随之反转。
679	- 两个参数填的都必须是各自 **`audit` 成功输出（stdout）里的 `reportId`**（随后也可用 `report` 读回确认），**不是产物哈希**。产物哈希相同只说明两份报告审计的产物内容相同，不能拿它当报告标识。
680	- `diff` 只**读取已保存的结论**做比较：不会重新检查合约，不启动符号执行或模糊测试，不重新解释证据，也不写入或修改报告目录。
681	
682	### 完整离线示例：缺陷总数从 1 变成 0，却没有“已消除缺陷”
683	
684	下面两份提交审计**完全相同的产物内容**（同样的 `abi`、`bytecode`、`source`），使用**同一条带版本的规则** `reentrancy-guard` `1.4.2`：基准报告记录“发现缺陷”并附具体反例，新报告记录“超时”并附具体超时说明。
685	
686	第一份提交保存为 `baseline.json`：
687	
688	```json
689	{
690	  "artifact": {
691	    "name": "Vault",
692	    "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\",\"type\":\"function\",\"stateMutability\":\"payable\"}]",
693	    "bytecode": "0x6080604052",
694	    "source": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\ncontract Vault {\n    mapping(address => uint256) private balances;\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {\n        (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        require(sent, \"transfer failed\");\n        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;\n    }\n}\n"
695	  },
696	  "rules": [
697	    {
698	      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
699	      "kind": "static",
700	      "severity": "high",
701	      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
702	      "requiresABI": false,
703	      "version": "1.4.2"
704	    }
705	  ],
706	  "invariants": {},
707	  "checks": [
708	    {
709	      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
710	      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
711	      "version": "1.4.2",
712	      "status": "发现缺陷",
713	      "note": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；外部 call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
714	    }
715	  ]
716	}
717	```
718	
719	第二份提交保存为 `rerun.json`（产物三个字符串字段与规则定义逐字相同，仅检查状态与说明不同）：
720	
721	```json
722	{
723	  "artifact": {
724	    "name": "Vault",
725	    "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\",\"type\":\"function\",\"stateMutability\":\"payable\"}]",
726	    "bytecode": "0x6080604052",

728	  },
729	  "rules": [
730	    {
731	      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
732	      "kind": "static",
733	      "severity": "high",
734	      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
735	      "requiresABI": false,
736	      "version": "1.4.2"
737	    }
738	  ],
739	  "invariants": {},
740	  "checks": [
741	    {
742	      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
743	      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
744	      "version": "1.4.2",
745	      "status": "超时",
746	      "note": "符号执行在 300s 截止时间到达时仍未遍历完 withdraw 的重入状态空间，作业被调度器中止，本次未得出通过或缺陷结论。"
747	    }

754	（由相同的 `abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 内容算出，名称 `Vault` 不参与），`version` 都与规则的 `1.4.2` 相符。

756	依次提交，从成功输出中取用两个 `reportId`：
757

759	mkdir -p reports
760	go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit --input baseline.json --store ./reports

816	          "evidence": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；外部 call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
817	        }
818	      },
819	      "after": {
820	        "rule": {
821	          "id": "reentrancy-guard",
822	          "kind": "static",
823	          "severity": "high",
824	          "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
825	          "requiresABI": false,
826	          "version": "1.4.2",
827	          "status": "超时",
828	          "note": "符号执行在 300s 截止时间到达时仍未遍历完 withdraw 的重入状态空间，作业被调度器中止，本次未得出通过或缺陷结论。"
829	        },
830	        "finding": null
831	      }
832	    }
833	  ],
834	  "summary": {
835	    "newDefects": 0,
836	    "resolvedDefects": 0,
837	    "statusChanges": 1,
838	    "noteChanges": 0,
839	    "noChange": 0,
840	    "addedRules": 0,
841	    "removedRules": 0,
842	    "changedRules": 0,
843	    "beforeDefects": 1,
844	    "afterDefects": 0
845	  }
846	}
847	```
848	
849	如何读这份结果：
850	
851	- 这条规则的 `change` 是 **“检查状态变化”**，**不是“已消除缺陷”**。基准侧（`before`）原样保留 `发现缺陷` 状态和 finding，finding 的 `evidence` 就是提交时的反例原文；新侧（`after`）只有 `超时` 状态和超时说明，`finding` 为 `null`。两侧结论与原始证据都能在这一个结果条目里直接找到，需要完整报告时再用 `report --id <reportId>` 读回。
852	- **缺陷总数与变化分类是两类不同字段。** `summary.beforeDefects = 1`、`afterDefects = 0` 只数两侧各自归档的真实 finding 条数（超时、工具缺失不产生 finding）；`newDefects` / `resolvedDefects` 则是对“发生了什么变化”的归类。本例两者都是 0：新报告缺陷数变少，仅仅是因为这次检查**超时、没有得出结论**，并没有一条 `发现缺陷 → 通过` 的迁移。
853	- **超时不代表检查通过，也不能据此推断缺陷已修复或已消除。** 手头唯一的具体证据仍是基准侧那条重入反例；新侧说明只证明“这次没查完”。`工具缺失`、`未检查` 同理：凡是涉及这几种非正常结论的状态迁移，一律归为“检查状态变化”。
854	- **只有规则定义完全一致时才比较检查状态**：同一 `ruleId` 的 `version`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`requiresABI` 全部相同，才可能出现 **`通过 → 发现缺陷` 计为“新发现缺陷”（`newDefects`）**、反向 **`发现缺陷 → 通过` 计为“已消除缺陷”（`resolvedDefects`）**。
855	- **规则版本或其他定义不同则归为“规则变化”（`changedRules`）**，两侧仍各自保留状态与证据，但不能据此推断修复或新增缺陷。例如把新提交的规则版本改成 `1.4.3`（checks 中的版本同步改为 `1.4.3`），输出就是 `"change": "规则变化"`、`"changedRules": 1`，而 `newDefects` 与 `resolvedDefects` 仍为 0——即使 `beforeDefects` 为 1、`afterDefects` 为 0。
856	
857	### 比较结果的分类与字段
858	
859	每个在任一侧出现过的规则标识恰好产生一个 `results` 条目，按 `ruleId` 排序；该侧没有这条规则时对应一侧为 `null`。`change` 沿用既有八类：
860	
861	| change | 含义 |
862	| --- | --- |
863	| `新发现缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `通过 → 发现缺陷` |
864	| `已消除缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `发现缺陷 → 通过` |
865	| `检查状态变化` | 定义一致，但状态迁移不属于上面两种（涉及 `超时`、`工具缺失`、`未检查` 等） |
866	| `检查说明变化` | 状态相同，仅 note 不同 |
867	| `无变化` | 状态与说明都相同 |
868	| `新增规则` / `移除规则` | 规则标识只在新侧 / 基准侧出现 |
869	| `规则变化` | 同名规则的版本或其他定义字段不同，不比较检查状态 |
870	
871	`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。
872	
873	### diff 失败条件（非零退出，无部分结果，不动归档）
874	
875	报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 没有任何比较片段（即使第一份报告已成功读取也不会输出部分结果），报告目录与已有归档保持原样（不创建目录、不修复或改写损坏文件、不留临时文件）：
876	
877	- 标识格式不合法：
878	
879	  ```text
880	  diff failed: invalid report id xyz: want 64 lowercase hex characters
881	  ```
882	
883	- 任一报告在目录中不存在（含报告目录本身不存在）：
884	
885	  ```text
886	  diff failed: report 0000…0000 not found
887	  ```
888	
889	- 任一归档损坏或内容与标识不符：
890	
891	  ```text
892	  diff failed: invalid JSON in report 738004a6…0e4e0: invalid character 'b' looking for beginning of object key string
893	  ```
894	
895	- 任一归档的规则定义里，正式 `requiresABI` 成员写成了 `null`、字符串、数字、对象或数组等非布尔值：
896	
897	  ```text
898	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rule reentrancy-guard: requiresABI must be a boolean
899	  ```
900	
901	  `null` 会被解码静默当成 `false`，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成 `false` 的规则拿去判断“规则变化”或“无变化”。省略 `requiresABI` 仍按 `false`，合法 `true` / `false` 的既有比较行为不变。
902	
903	- 任一归档的规则文本成员（正式的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note`）写成了 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组等非字符串值：
904	
905	  ```text
906	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: rules[0] (rule owner-only-withdraw): note must be a string
907	  ```
908	
909	  `null` 会被解码静默当成空字符串，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成空字符串的内容拿去判断“无变化”。省略成员仍按既有默认值处理，已有合法报告的比较分类与统计保持不变。
910	
911	- 任一归档 `findings` 中某条缺陷记录的文本成员（正式的 `artifactHash`、`ruleId`、`version`、`severity`、`invariant`、`evidence`）写成了 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组等非字符串值：
912	
913	  ```text
914	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 archive is corrupt: findings[0] (rule r-empty): severity must be a string
915	  ```
916	
917	  `null` 会被解码静默当成空字符串：规则与缺陷记录都保存空文本的合法报告，把记录里的 `severity` 或 `invariant` 改成 `null` 后标识不变、绑定仍吻合，甚至会被误判为“无变化”。比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会依据被当成空字符串的错误值计算分类或统计。成员省略或显式写成空字符串仍按既有必填与绑定要求处理，已有合法报告的比较分类与统计保持不变。
918	
919	- 任一归档中某条“发现缺陷”规则的 `note` 是非空字符串却完全由空白组成（对应 finding 的 `evidence` 保存同一段空白、报告标识与内容一致也不例外）：
920	
921	  ```text
922	  diff failed: report a6fa091b…3b34 rule reentrancy-guard status 发现缺陷 has a blank note
923	  ```
924	
925	  比较前的校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较分类或统计。只提交不变式布尔值生成的无说明缺陷报告（证据为 `invariant <不变式名> does not hold`）不受影响，已有合法报告的比较结果保持不变。
926	
927	## 仅提交不变式布尔值（既有用法，保持不变）
928	
929	在 checks 导入能力之前就存在的用法仍然有效：提交只给 `invariants`（不变式名到布尔值的映射）而不给 `checks`。值为 `false` 的不变式使引用它的规则记为 `发现缺陷` 并生成 finding，证据为 `invariant <不变式名> does not hold`；值为 `true` 记为 `通过`；未出现的规则记为 `未检查`。
930	
931	```json
932	{
933	  "artifact": {"name": "Vault", "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\"}]", "bytecode": "0x6080", "source": "Vault.sol"},
934	  "rules": [
935	    {"id": "reentrancy-guard", "kind": "static", "severity": "high", "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw", "requiresABI": false, "version": "1.0.0"}
936	  ],
937	  "invariants": {"no-reentrant-withdraw": false}
938	}
939	```
940	
941	checks 导入的补充**不改变**输入格式、报告内容或现有命令的行为：上述提交的字段、生成的报告与报告标识都与以前一致。
942

## 比较两份已保存的报告（diff）

`diff` 从**同一个报告目录**中读取两份已经落盘的报告，逐规则比较并输出确定性的比较 JSON（无时间戳，重复比较同一对报告结果逐字节一致）。

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
  --store ./reports \
  --before <基准报告 reportId> \
  --after <新报告 reportId>
```

`./cs diff ...` 与上面的 `go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff ...` 等价，全程离线。

三个参数各选什么：

- **`--store`**：两份报告共同所在的报告目录，与 `audit`、`report` 用的是同一个目录参数。
- **`--before`**：基准报告（当作对照的较早一次审计）；**`--after`**：新报告。
- **比较方向只由两个标识所在的参数位置决定**：工具不按文件时间或归档顺序猜测方向。交换两个参数，所有“新发现/已消除”的方向随之反转。
- 两个参数填的都必须是各自 **`audit` 成功输出（stdout）里的 `reportId`**（随后也可用 `report` 读回确认），**不是产物哈希**。产物哈希相同只说明两份报告审计的产物内容相同，不能拿它当报告标识。
- `diff` 只**读取已保存的结论**做比较：不会重新检查合约，不启动符号执行或模糊测试，不重新解释证据，也不写入或修改报告目录。

### 完整离线示例：缺陷总数从 1 变成 0，却没有“已消除缺陷”

下面两份提交审计**完全相同的产物内容**（同样的 `abi`、`bytecode`、`source`），使用**同一条带版本的规则** `reentrancy-guard` `1.4.2`：基准报告记录“发现缺陷”并附具体反例，新报告记录“超时”并附具体超时说明。

第一份提交保存为 `baseline.json`：

```json
{
  "artifact": {
    "name": "Vault",
    "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\",\"type\":\"function\",\"stateMutability\":\"payable\"}]",
    "bytecode": "0x6080604052",
    "source": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\ncontract Vault {\n    mapping(address => uint256) private balances;\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {\n        (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        require(sent, \"transfer failed\");\n        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;\n    }\n}\n"
  },
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "high",
      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "1.4.2"
    }
  ],
  "invariants": {},
  "checks": [
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
      "version": "1.4.2",
      "status": "发现缺陷",
      "note": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；外部 call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
    }
  ]
}
```

第二份提交保存为 `rerun.json`（产物三个字符串字段与规则定义逐字相同，仅检查状态与说明不同）：

```json
{
  "artifact": {
    "name": "Vault",
    "abi": "[{\"name\":\"withdraw\",\"type\":\"function\",\"stateMutability\":\"payable\"}]",
    "bytecode": "0x6080604052",
    "source": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\ncontract Vault {\n    mapping(address => uint256) private balances;\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {\n        (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        require(sent, \"transfer failed\");\n        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;\n    }\n}\n"
  },
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "reentrancy-guard",
      "kind": "static",
      "severity": "high",
      "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
      "requiresABI": false,
      "version": "1.4.2"
    }
  ],
  "invariants": {},
  "checks": [
    {
      "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
      "version": "1.4.2",
      "status": "超时",
      "note": "符号执行在 300s 截止时间到达时仍未遍历完 withdraw 的重入状态空间，作业被调度器中止，本次未得出通过或缺陷结论。"
    }
  ]
}
```

绑定值都是确定的、无需读者补齐：两份提交 checks 里的 `artifactHash` 都是
`0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7`
（由相同的 `abi`、`bytecode`、`source` 内容算出，名称 `Vault` 不参与），`version` 都与规则的 `1.4.2` 相符。

依次提交，从成功输出中取用两个 `reportId`：

```bash
mkdir -p reports
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit --input baseline.json --store ./reports
# reportId: fd2b18fc0819786bc466a3bc8f5a60ffbf24d44e86d0b9b2bd09495bb80383dc
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel audit --input rerun.json    --store ./reports
# reportId: 738004a606559b08a2beb04382ea1ef2c9ec81869081c27e7dd153e840d0e4e0
```

把基准标识放在 `--before`、新标识放在 `--after`：

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
  --store ./reports \
  --before fd2b18fc0819786bc466a3bc8f5a60ffbf24d44e86d0b9b2bd09495bb80383dc \
  --after  738004a606559b08a2beb04382ea1ef2c9ec81869081c27e7dd153e840d0e4e0
```

本机离线输出（与仓库中 `contractsentinel` 的比较分类和报告格式一致）：

```json
{
  "before": {
    "reportId": "fd2b18fc0819786bc466a3bc8f5a60ffbf24d44e86d0b9b2bd09495bb80383dc",
    "artifact": {
      "name": "Vault",
      "hash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7"
    }
  },
  "after": {
    "reportId": "738004a606559b08a2beb04382ea1ef2c9ec81869081c27e7dd153e840d0e4e0",
    "artifact": {
      "name": "Vault",
      "hash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7"
    }
  },
  "artifactNameChanged": false,
  "artifactHashChanged": false,
  "results": [
    {
      "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
      "change": "检查状态变化",
      "before": {
        "rule": {
          "id": "reentrancy-guard",
          "kind": "static",
          "severity": "high",
          "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
          "requiresABI": false,
          "version": "1.4.2",
          "status": "发现缺陷",
          "note": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；外部 call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
        },
        "finding": {
          "artifactHash": "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7",
          "ruleId": "reentrancy-guard",
          "version": "1.4.2",
          "severity": "high",
          "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
          "evidence": "反例：攻击者先存入 1 ether 后调用 withdraw；外部 call 在 balances 扣减前把控制权交给攻击合约的 receive，receive 重入 withdraw，此时 balances[msg.sender] 仍是旧值，同一笔余额被第二次转出。"
        }
      },
      "after": {
        "rule": {
          "id": "reentrancy-guard",
          "kind": "static",
          "severity": "high",
          "invariant": "no-reentrant-withdraw",
          "requiresABI": false,
          "version": "1.4.2",
          "status": "超时",
          "note": "符号执行在 300s 截止时间到达时仍未遍历完 withdraw 的重入状态空间，作业被调度器中止，本次未得出通过或缺陷结论。"
        },
        "finding": null
      }
    }
  ],
  "summary": {
    "newDefects": 0,
    "resolvedDefects": 0,
    "statusChanges": 1,
    "noteChanges": 0,
    "noChange": 0,
    "addedRules": 0,
    "removedRules": 0,
    "changedRules": 0,
    "beforeDefects": 1,
    "afterDefects": 0
  }
}
```

如何读这份结果：

- 这条规则的 `change` 是 **“检查状态变化”**，**不是“已消除缺陷”**。基准侧（`before`）原样保留 `发现缺陷` 状态和 finding，finding 的 `evidence` 就是提交时的反例原文；新侧（`after`）只有 `超时` 状态和超时说明，`finding` 为 `null`。两侧结论与原始证据都能在这一个结果条目里直接找到，需要完整报告时再用 `report --id <reportId>` 读回。
- **缺陷总数与变化分类是两类不同字段。** `summary.beforeDefects = 1`、`afterDefects = 0` 只数两侧各自归档的真实 finding 条数（超时、工具缺失不产生 finding）；`newDefects` / `resolvedDefects` 则是对“发生了什么变化”的归类。本例两者都是 0：新报告缺陷数变少，仅仅是因为这次检查**超时、没有得出结论**，并没有一条 `发现缺陷 → 通过` 的迁移。
- **超时不代表检查通过，也不能据此推断缺陷已修复或已消除。** 手头唯一的具体证据仍是基准侧那条重入反例；新侧说明只证明“这次没查完”。`工具缺失`、`未检查` 同理：凡是涉及这几种非正常结论的状态迁移，一律归为“检查状态变化”。
- **只有规则定义完全一致时才比较检查状态**：同一 `ruleId` 的 `version`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`requiresABI` 全部相同，才可能出现 **`通过 → 发现缺陷` 计为“新发现缺陷”（`newDefects`）**、反向 **`发现缺陷 → 通过` 计为“已消除缺陷”（`resolvedDefects`）**。
- **规则版本或其他定义不同则归为“规则变化”（`changedRules`）**，两侧仍各自保留状态与证据，但不能据此推断修复或新增缺陷。例如把新提交的规则版本改成 `1.4.3`（checks 中的版本同步改为 `1.4.3`），输出就是 `"change": "规则变化"`、`"changedRules": 1`，而 `newDefects` 与 `resolvedDefects` 仍为 0——即使 `beforeDefects` 为 1、`afterDefects` 为 0。

### 比较结果的分类与字段

每个在任一侧出现过的规则标识恰好产生一个 `results` 条目，按 `ruleId` 排序；该侧没有这条规则时对应一侧为 `null`。`change` 沿用既有八类：

| change | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `新发现缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `通过 → 发现缺陷` |
| `已消除缺陷` | 定义完全一致，且状态 `发现缺陷 → 通过` |
| `检查状态变化` | 定义一致，但状态迁移不属于上面两种（涉及 `超时`、`工具缺失`、`未检查` 等） |
| `检查说明变化` | 状态相同，仅 note 不同 |
| `无变化` | 状态与说明都相同 |
| `新增规则` / `移除规则` | 规则标识只在新侧 / 基准侧出现 |
| `规则变化` | 同名规则的版本或其他定义字段不同，不比较检查状态 |

`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。

### diff 失败条件（非零退出，无部分结果，不动归档）

报告标识必须是**恰好 64 位小写十六进制字符串**。下列情况命令都以**非零状态退出**，原因写入 **stderr**，stdout 没有任何比较片段（即使第一份报告已成功读取也不会输出部分结果），报告目录与已有归档保持原样（不创建目录、不修复或改写损坏文件、不留临时文件）：

- 标识格式不合法：

  ```text
  diff failed: invalid report id xyz: want 64 lowercase hex characters
  ```

- 任一报告在目录中不存在（含报告目录本身不存在）：

  ```text
  diff failed: report 0000…0000 not found
  ```

- 任一归档损坏或内容与标识不符：

  ```text
  diff failed: invalid JSON in report 738004a6…0e4e0: invalid character 'b' looking for beginning of object key string
  ```

  ```text

  ```

  `null` 会被解码静默当成 `false`，损坏归档因此可能与合法归档同标识，甚至被误判为“无变化”；比较前的类型校验会先拒绝整份归档，**任一侧**命中都直接失败，不输出任何比较结果，也不会把被默认成 `false` 的规则拿去判断“规则变化”或“无变化”。省略 `requiresABI` 仍按 `false`，合法 `true` / `false` 的既有比较行为不变。

- 任一归档的规则文本成员（正式的 `id`、`kind`、`severity`、`invariant`、`version`、`status`、`note`）写成了 `null`、布尔值、数字、对象或数组等非字符串值：


I've further identified the trigger for this ID collision: both the "good" and previously broken reports were generated from the exact same audit submission. The duplicate ID mechanism only returns an error when the first of the two identical-ID reports is queried.

I've confirmed this error aligns with the failure scenario requirements, and clarified the correction plan: adjust the audit configuration of the "broken" report to make its ID differ from the "good" report, and modify the matching rule's evidence substring to account for escaped newlines. I will now apply both fixes.

import json, subprocess, os

ABI = '[{"name":"withdraw","type":"function","stateMutability":"payable"}]'
BC = "0x6080604052"
SRC = "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\ncontract Vault {\n    mapping(address => uint256) private balances;\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {\n        (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        require(sent, \"transfer failed\");\n        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;\n    }\n}\n"
H = "0cdb899734304f7aac91e746f5332c248c94bf0877ae37d0848409bd0b3a8ca7"

def sub(checks):
    return {
        "artifact": {"name": "Vault", "abi": ABI, "bytecode": BC, "source": SRC},
        "rules": [
            {"id": "reentrancy-guard", "kind": "static", "severity": "high", "invariant": "inv-r", "requiresABI": False, "version": "1.4.2"},
            {"id": "access-control", "kind": "static", "severity": "medium", "invariant": "inv-a", "requiresABI": False, "version": "1"},
        ],
        "invariants": {},
        "checks": checks,
    }

input.old_string:
`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。

input.new_string:
`before` / `after` 两侧的 `rule` 是该侧完整规则（含 `version`、`status`、`note`）；`finding` 仅在该侧该规则为 `发现缺陷` 时出现，携带当侧归档的 `artifactHash`、`version` 与逐字证据。顶层 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged` 标明两侧产物是否同名同内容。`summary` 中八类计数与逐条 `change` 一一对应且零值也总是出现，`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 是两侧缺陷总数。

### 只查看一条规则的变化（可选 `--rule`）

比较两份报告时可以额外给出 `--rule <规则标识>`，把比较结果限定在这一条规则上：

```bash
go run ./cmd/contractsentinel diff \
  --store ./reports \
  --before <基准报告 reportId> \
  --after <新报告 reportId> \
  --rule reentrancy-guard
```

筛选后的输出与完整比较是**同一个结构**：

- 顶层仍保留实际比较的两份报告标识（`before.reportId` / `after.reportId`）、两侧产物名称与哈希，以及 `artifactNameChanged` / `artifactHashChanged`——这两个标记描述的是两份报告整体的产物差异，即使所选规则本身“无变化”也照常给出。
- `results` 只包含所选规则的一个条目，仍是数组。条目的分类规则与完整比较完全相同：定义完全一致时才比较状态，版本、检查种类、严重级别、不变式或 ABI 要求有变化仍归 **“规则变化”**；涉及工具缺失、超时、未检查的状态迁移仍归 **“检查状态变化”**，不会因为只看一条规则就把它们推断成新增或消除缺陷。
- `summary` 与返回的唯一条目对应：该条目所属分类计一，其余七类为零。`beforeDefects` / `afterDefects` 在这里各为**零或一**，只表示这条规则在对应报告中是否有真实缺陷记录；同一份报告里其他规则的缺陷不计入。例如两份报告都还有别的缺陷，但所选规则定义一致、从“通过”变成“发现缺陷”，结果只计一条“新发现缺陷”，两个缺陷数为零和一。

95	// DiffStore loads both reports from the store and compares them. Both reports
96	// are fully verified before any comparison happens; any failure yields an
97	// error and no partial result.
98	func DiffStore(dir, beforeID, afterID string) (DiffResult, error) {
99		before, err := LoadReportForDiff(dir, beforeID)
100		if err != nil {
101			return DiffResult{}, err
102		}
103		after, err := LoadReportForDiff(dir, afterID)
104		if err != nil {
105			return DiffResult{}, err
106		}
107		return DiffReports(before, after), nil
108	}
109	
110	// DiffStoreRule works exactly like DiffStore — both archives are loaded and
111	// fully verified first, the store is only read — but the returned comparison
112	// keeps only the result for ruleID. The rule id is matched against its
113	// complete text exactly: case and surrounding spaces are part of the id, so
114	// "R1" and " R1 " never match "r1". The output keeps the full comparison
115	// shape: the two report refs, artifact name/hash flags and the one selected
116	// result entry, which is classified by the same rules as the full diff. The
117	// summary counts only that entry, and beforeDefects/afterDefects are each
118	// zero or one — whether the selected rule has a real defect finding on that
119	// side, independently of defects other rules have in the same report.
120	//
121	// The filter never bypasses archive verification: a missing, corrupt or
122	// illegitimately bound archive fails with the usual error even when the
123	// problem is on another rule, and only after both archives have passed does
124	// the filter itself get validated. An explicitly empty rule id, or an id
125	// neither report contains, is then an input error and no result is returned.
126	func DiffStoreRule(dir, beforeID, afterID, ruleID string) (DiffResult, error) {
127		before, err := LoadReportForDiff(dir, beforeID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return DiffResult{}, err
130		}
131		after, err := LoadReportForDiff(dir, afterID)
132		if err != nil {
133			return DiffResult{}, err
134		}
135		if ruleID == "" {
136			return DiffResult{}, errInvalid("rule id filter must not be empty")
137		}
138		full := DiffReports(before, after)
139		for i := range full.Results {
140			if full.Results[i].RuleID != ruleID {
141				continue
142			}
143			entry := full.Results[i]
144			full.Results = []RuleDiff{entry}
145			full.Summary = summaryForEntry(entry)
146			return full, nil
147		}
148		return DiffResult{}, errInvalid("rule " + ruleID + " not found in either report")
149	}
150	
151	// summaryForEntry builds the summary of a one-rule comparison: the single
152	// category the entry belongs to plus the per-side real-defect presence, each
153	// zero or one. A side carries a finding exactly when that report recorded a
154	// real defect for the rule; tool-missing, timeout and unchecked sides do not.
155	func summaryForEntry(entry RuleDiff) DiffSummary {
156		s := DiffSummary{}
157		switch entry.Change {
158		case ChangeNewDefect:
159			s.NewDefects = 1
160		case ChangeResolvedDefect:
161			s.ResolvedDefects = 1
162		case ChangeStatusChanged:
163			s.StatusChanges = 1
164		case ChangeNoteChanged:
165			s.NoteChanges = 1
166		case ChangeNoChange:
167			s.NoChange = 1
168		case ChangeRuleAdded:
169			s.AddedRules = 1
